## New in this version

- **The title song loops:** _Dust and Death's Call_ now plays on for as long as you stay on the title screen, instead of giving way to the old tune.
- **A lighter searchlight:** on Enhanced graphics a lit searchlight now costs about as much as a dark one, with the same look and shadows.
- **Update in place:** the launcher's Update button installs this version for you.

## Download

Download the file for your system:

| System                                      | File                          |
| ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Windows 10 or 11                            | `Dead-West-Railway-Setup.exe` |
| macOS 13 or newer (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `Dead-West-Railway.dmg`       |
| Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!\_OS       | `dead-west-railway_amd64.deb` |
| Linux: any other distribution               | `Dead-West-Railway.AppImage`  |

Windows and macOS ask you to confirm the first time you open the game. The steps are in the [install guide](https://github.com/Joshspeakman/dead-west-railway#install).
